name: Back in Stock Alert
summary: Selected-variant and current-market availability-request profile that composes canonical Input and Button, presents idle/submitting/confirmed/retryable-error states, and leaves provider truth and delivery to the target integration.

variants.name: default
variants.description: One intrinsic notification-form profile; field validation variants belong to canonical Input.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One container-responsive size that stacks from its own inline capacity.

states.name: idle
states.description: Resting form with no provider result claim.

states.name: fieldError
states.description: Canonical Input error validation composition; aria-invalid and error text remain Input/target obligations.

states.name: fieldSuccess
states.description: Canonical Input successful field-validation composition, distinct from provider acceptance.

states.name: submitting
states.description: A target registration request is in flight; the email is read-only and canonical Button busy/disabled semantics prevent repeat activation.

states.name: confirmed
states.description: Provider acceptance is confirmed; the form remains visible, email remains readable and focusable, resubmission is disabled, and adjacent truthful feedback uses status semantics.

states.name: retryableError
states.description: Provider registration failed without losing context; the field remains editable, submit remains available, and adjacent truthful error feedback is announced.

behavior.name: requiredComposition
behavior.description: Targets omit the complete root when the heading or valid native form composition is absent; required child labels and action names also fail closed in adapters.

behavior.name: nativeNotificationForm
behavior.description: Web preserves native validation, successful-entry construction, activated submitter and reset; the target supplies action/method and may navigate or intercept the same complete form data.

behavior.name: inputComposition
behavior.description: Canonical Input remains the sole email value, label, name, validation, associated-message, icon, disabled, focus, hover and controlled/uncontrolled owner.

behavior.name: buttonComposition
behavior.description: The explicit submitter composes canonical primary Button and preserves Button-owned activation, focus, disabled, busy, loading and reduced-motion behavior.

behavior.name: notificationTarget
attributes: target-owned exact selected variant and current market form/model data
behavior.description: The form is eligible only with one exact selected variant and current market. D8 names those semantic identities without prescribing provider field names, schemas or transport.

behavior.name: availabilityBoundary
behavior.description: The connected target inventory authority decides when the selected variant becomes purchasable under the current market policy; preorder, backorder, incoming and reserved states are not silently equivalent.

behavior.name: requestStateBoundary
behavior.description: D8 owns coherent request-state presentation while the target integration supplies truthful transitions. Confirmed and retryable-error require non-empty localized feedback or resolve to idle; native submit alone never confirms success.

behavior.name: consentBoundary
behavior.description: Availability-service consent is explicit and separate from marketing consent. Provider verification, idempotency, abuse controls, retention, deletion, delivery, retry and unsubscribe remain target responsibilities.

behavior.name: intrinsicLayout
behavior.description: The composition responds to its own inline size without viewport breakpoints, reordered DOM or changed keyboard order.

behavior.name: zeroNeutralRuntime
behavior.description: Neutral D8 owns no listener, observer, timer, request, storage, formatter, layout read, custom element, asset, animation or provider runtime.

accessibility: Use one real native form named by the non-empty visible heading and preserve native constraint validation, submit, FormData and reset behavior.

Compose the email control from canonical Input with a visible associated label, stable target field name, type=email, autocomplete=email, required communication and associated guidance or validation text.
Preserve Input's Default, Error, Success and Warning families; use aria-invalid only for Error and never treat successful field validation as provider acceptance.
Compose the explicit submitter from canonical Button; submitting uses Button busy plus native disabled semantics and preserves the visible label while preventing repeat activation.
Supply the exact selected variant and current market, invalidate stale context on either change and do not submit an ambiguous notification request.
Do not announce or display confirmed registration until the target provider accepts it; keep field validation separate from form-level response feedback.

Keep the form in place after confirmation, preserve focus/context, make the email read-only, disable resubmission and expose truthful adjacent status. Retryable error restores editing/submission and uses error announcement semantics.
Keep notification-purpose copy and any required consent/privacy information explicit; do not imply unrelated marketing consent.
Preserve Input-then-Button source, reading and keyboard order when the container stacks, localizes or changes direction.

web.notes: Intrinsic CSS composes canonical Input and Button and presents coherent request states with zero neutral runtime; the target drives transitions from the exact variant, market and provider result.

shopify.notes: Main Product hosts provider app blocks, publishes current variant and market context, replaces the app block with every variant render and emits both identities. The installed app owns registration, consent, inventory observation and delivery; the theme ships no notification database or fake endpoint.

react.notes: The shared Exhibit/Studio renderer composes canonical Input/Button and proves idle, submitting, confirmed and retryable-error presentation while the framework integration owns provider transitions.
